title: Lantern Nights
description: Cozy aesthetic survival modpack for peaceful Minecraft nights.
body:
Lantern Nights is a cozy aesthetic Minecraft modpack focused on peaceful survival, atmospheric exploration, warm lantern lighting, and relaxing nighttime vibes.

Built around shaders, ambient sounds, beautiful world generation, cozy building mods, and peaceful immersion, this pack is designed for slow survival gameplay — whether you're building riverside villages during rainstorms, exploring cherry blossom forests at night, or farming while listening to calm Korean and Japanese music.

Features:
• Beautiful terrain generation
• Cozy building and furniture mods
• Atmospheric audio and weather
• Enhanced third-person gameplay
• Peaceful exploration
• Performance optimization
• Shader-focused visuals

Recommended for:
late-night survival sessions, aesthetic Minecraft players, cottagecore builders, cinematic exploration, and relaxing worlds with friends.

Build • Explore • Relax • Repeat 🌙
